exact_text:
As long as you're trading in the direction of the trend, these upper and lower limits may be attractive
entry and exit points if, as always, confirmed by other indicators.
added_conditions: trading in the direction of the trend

exact_text:
In flat or mild trends, the price
tends to fluctuate between the upper and lower bands, as price bounces off the upper and lower bands
like a ball bouncing off the floor and ceiling.
added_conditions: flat, range-bound markets or gently trending markets (no change in the market's perception of value)

added_parameters.name: probability of price hitting the bands

exact_text:
a. Occurs after extended move lower = Inverted Hammer, bullish, suggests markets hitting
bottom, confirmed by a bounce higher
added_conditions: occurs after an extended move lower (Inverted Hammer, bullish) or an extended move higher (Shooting Star, bearish)
needs start of reversal to confirm the pattern

added_parameters.name: upper wick length relative to body
added_parameters.value: two to three times the length of the body

exact_text:
Three White Soldiers – Bullish
This pattern is comprised of three long-bodied bullish (higher close) candles after a
downtrend, and signals a longer-term reversal higher.
added_conditions: second candle's body should be longer than that of the first and close near its high with little or no upper wick
third candle's body should be the same size or larger than that of the second and close at or near its high with little or no upper wick

exact_text:
you'd be anticipating a new move lower, typically about the same distance
again as the distance from the peaks to the neckline
added_conditions: price falls below the neckline (the lowest closing price between the two tops), confirming the reversal
